title: Assistant Manager – Refurb & Service Operations
jobDescription: About Yulu Yulu is India’s largest shared electric mobility-as-a-service company. Yulu’s mission is to reduce traffic congestion and air pollution by running smart, shared, and small-sized electric vehicles. A mission-driven & seasoned founding team leads Yulu and has won several prestigious awards for its impact and innovation. Yulu is currently enabling daily commuters for short-distance movements and helping gig workers deliver goods for the last mile with its eco-friendly rides at pocket-friendly prices, thereby reducing its carbon footprint. Yulu is excited to welcome people with high integrity, commitment, the ability to collaborate and take ownership, high curiosity, and an appetite for taking intelligent risks. If our mission brings a spark into your eyes and if you’d like to join a passionate team that’s committed to transforming how people commute, work, and explore their cities, come, join the #Unstoppable Yulu tribe! Stay updated on the latest news from Yulu at https://www.yulu.bike/newsroom and our website, https://www.yulu.bike/. Role Summary We are looking for an Assistant Manager – Refurb & Service Operations (EV) to manage and maintain our refurbishment workshop in Mumbai. The role involves end-to-end ownership of mechanical and electrical component debugging, repair quality, and team leadership. The ideal candidate must have strong technical knowledge of EV bikes and hands-on experience in service and repair operations. Key Responsibilities * Manage and oversee daily refurbishment and service operations at the Mumbai workshop. * Ensure smooth workflow, adherence to SOPs, and high-quality repair output. * Own component-level diagnosis, debugging, repair, testing, and final quality checks. * Lead, mentor, and monitor the technician team to meet daily and monthly KPIs. * Drive service performance metrics: TAT, productivity, first-time fix rate, and quality score. * Conduct audits, ensure documentation accuracy, and maintain safety compliance. * Track repair trends, generate reports, and support continuous improvement initiatives. * Coordinate with city operations, quality, R&D, and supply chain teams for issue closure. Required Skills & Experience * 4+ years of experience in the EV industry in service/repair operations. * Strong understanding of EV bikes, electrical systems, and mechanical assemblies. * Prior experience handling workshops or refurbishment centres. * Good team management, communication, and analytical skills. title: Learning Content Associate
jobDescription:
About Yulu Yulu is India’s largest shared electric mobility-as-a-service company. Yulu’s mission is to reduce traffic congestion and air pollution by running smart, shared, and small-sized electric vehicles. A mission-driven & seasoned founding team leads Yulu and has won several prestigious awards for its impact and innovation. Yulu is currently enabling daily commuters for short-distance movements and helping gig workers deliver goods for the last mile with its eco-friendly rides at pocket-friendly prices, thereby reducing its carbon footprint. Yulu is excited to welcome people with high integrity, commitment, the ability to collaborate and take ownership, high curiosity, and an appetite for taking intelligent risks. If our mission brings a spark into your eyes and if you’d like to join a passionate team that’s committed to transforming how people commute, work, and explore their cities, come, join the #Unstoppable Yulu tribe! Stay updated on the latest news from Yulu at https://www.yulu.bike/newsroom and our website, https://www.yulu.bike/. About the Role As a Learning Content Associate, you will help create training content that is simple, accurate, and easy to understand for our teams. You will work closely with a senior team member who will guide you on content structure, learning principles, and business context. This role is ideal for someone early in their career who enjoys learning new things, paying attention to detail, and turning complex information into clear content. What You Will Do
1. Create Training Presentations  Help create and update training decks based on inputs and discussions  Learn business processes and convert them into simple, learner-friendly slides  Ensure information is correct, clearly written, and well-structured
2. Support Training Video Creation  Assist in scripting and storyboarding training videos  Help shoot videos using a phone or basic camera  Edit videos (cuts, captions, basic visuals) with guidance
3. Maintain and Update Content  Update existing training material when processes change  Ensure only the latest and correct content is shared  Maintain basic version control
4. Support Learning Platforms (Future Scope)  Upload content to the LMS  Help organize training modules and materials What We’re Looking For Must-Have Traits  Willingness to learn and ask questions  Strong attention to detail  Ability to explain things simply  Sense of ownership — you care if something is right or wrong  Ability to work quickly while maintaining accuracy You Do Not Need  Prior experience in L&D  Deep process or technical knowledge  Advanced design or video skills (These will be taught.) Nice to Have (Not Mandatory)  Basic familiarity with Power Point / Google Slides  Interest in videos, editing, or visual content  Internship or project experience in content, training, or media What You’ll Learn in This Role  How to design effective training content  How to simplify technical and operational information  Basics of learning and adult learning principles  How to create training videos end-to-end Please note: This role requires a strong sense of ownership. title: Full Stack Engineer
jobDescription:
About Yulu Yulu is India’s largest shared electric mobility-as-a-service company. Yulu’s mission is to reduce traffic congestion and air pollution by running smart, shared, and small-sized electric vehicles. Yulu is led by a mission-driven & seasoned founding team and has won several prestigious awards for its impact and innovation. Yulu is currently enabling daily commuters for short-distance movements and helping gig-workers to deliver goods for the last mile with its eco-friendly rides at pocket-friendly prices, and reducing carbon footprint. Yulu is excited to welcome people with high integrity, commitment, the ability to collaborate and take ownership, high curiosity, and an appetite for taking intelligent risks. If our mission brings a spark into your eyes and if you’d like to join a passionate team that’s committed to transforming how people commute, work, and explore their cities
- Come, join the #Unstoppable Yulu tribe! Stay updated on the latest news from Yulu at https://www.yulu.bike/newsroom andon our website, https://www.yulu.bike/. Role Summary We are seeking a skilled and motivated Full Stack Engineer with a strong foundation in Node.js and SQL-based databases. As part of our team, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying scalable, efficient, and maintainable solutions. This role demands hands-on expertise in building web applications, APIs, and implementing robust data management strategies. Key Responsibilities * Responsible for the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of our applications and its various modules. * Work closely with Product, UX, and QA teams to deliver the product. * Reduce rework and improve productivity by designing first and then developing a methodology * Understand and fix customer incidents and defects * Frontend Framework: Expertise in building dynamic and responsive user interfaces using modern frameworks such as React or Angular. * Backend Framework: Strong experience with Node.js(Must have), Familiarity with Spring or Django is a plus. * Databases: Solid experience with My SQL(Must have), Knowledge of No SQL databases (e.g., Mongo DB) is an advantage. * Data Structures & Algorithms: Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms for efficient and optimized solutions. * Version Control: Working knowledge of at least one version control system, such as SVN, GIT, or a similar tool. * Knowledge of unit testing theory * Design and develop full-stack applications using Angular and Node.js. * Write clean, modular, and scalable code for frontend and backend development. * Optimize SQL queries and ensure efficient database interaction. * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand project requirements and deliver high-quality solutions. * Manage code repositories using Git and ensure streamlined version control. * Monitor, debug, and manage application processes with process management tools. * Stay updated with industry trends and integrate best practices into the development process Qualifications * We are seeking passionate, fresh graduates eager to learn and grow in this role * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related field or a related field * Graduates with demonstrated project experience or internships in relevant areas are strongly encouraged to apply We assure you * Be a part of an innovative company that values professional growth, trustworthy colleagues, a fun environment in the office, and well-being for employees * A culture that fosters growth, integrity, and innovation
